hook_text: One fun fair, every Term 1 skill. How many can you spot?
clip_script: Kimberley school fun fair. R245 368 raised. The 5 is worth 5 000. Rounded to the nearest 1 000: R245 000. Last year: R238 950. Which is bigger? Compare from the left: 4 beats 3. How much more? Subtract: R6 418. Check: add it back. 125 stalls at R240: double and halve to R30 000. 3 024 rolls in trays of 24: 126 trays. Brackets first, then times and divide, then plus and minus. Estimate and undo to check. That is your Term 1 toolkit.
visual_style: A fun fair scene where each stall shows a different skill, with numbers popping up on banners and a toolbox filling with tools.
mood: Festive and confident, like a victory lap.
pacing: Rapid-fire skills, one per stall, ending with a toolbox snapping shut.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the weekend visitor total.
